in_marathi.name: Shivkant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Shiva's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivkant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivkant is a name derived from the word 'Shiva' which means 'The God of Destruction and the Transformer'. Kant means 'Grace' or 'Power'. So, Shivkant means 'God Shiva's Grace' or 'The Power of God Shiva'.
